_comment: Mobile Event Rental field schema. Single-asset, date-based rental delivered to a venue. The dominant facts on any lead are: WHAT DATE, WHERE, HOW MANY GUESTS, WHICH PACKAGE, and IS THE VENUE PHYSICALLY VIABLE. Everything below serves one of those.

fields.name: Event Date
fields._why: The single most important field in the account. Drives availability, the deposit countdown, the balance-due countdown, the weather check and the review request. Nearly every workflow keys off this.

fields.name: Event Date Flexible?
fields._why: Turns a lost booking into a saved one. If the requested date is taken and they are flexible, you offer alternates instead of declining.

fields.name: Event Type
fields._why: Primary segmentation. Lead time, budget, decision-maker and objections differ per type; drives which nurture and which social proof to send.

fields.name: Event Start Time
fields._why: Setup and teardown sit OUTSIDE billed event time. Crew scheduling and travel buffer need the actual start, not just the date.

fields.name: Guest Count
fields._why: Drives package recommendation and throughput expectations.

fields.name: Guest Age Mix
fields._why: The add-on qualifier. Mixed or kid-heavy groups need the game add-on package, not the pure enthusiast experience.

fields.name: Package Interest
fields._why: GENERIC tier names, NOT client package names. Client renames the options at deployment; keeping them generic is what makes this snapshot reusable.

fields.name: Add-Ons Requested
fields._why: Add-ons are the margin. Capturing interest at inquiry makes the quote bigger and the follow-up specific.

fields.name: Venue Name
fields._why: Venue partners are a referral channel. Tracking venue names surfaces which venues repeat.

fields.name: Venue Address
fields._why: The event is NOT at the contact's home address. Separate field or the crew drives to the wrong place.

fields.name: Indoor or Outdoor
fields._why: Gates the entire weather-contingency track. Indoor events skip it; outdoor events get a forecast check and a contingency conversation.

fields.name: Space Confirmed?
fields._why: The #1 day-of failure in mobile rental: crew arrives and the unit does not fit. Confirming footprint BEFORE the deposit prevents a refund and a wasted trip.

fields.name: Ceiling Height Confirmed?
fields._why: Height kills more indoor bookings than floor space and nobody thinks to measure it.

fields.name: Power Access Confirmed?
fields._why: No power means no event. Also the trigger to sell the generator add-on.

fields.name: Access Notes
fields._why: Stairs, elevators, narrow doors, gate codes, parking, load-in distance. What the crew reads in the truck.

fields.name: Travel Distance (miles)
fields._why: Drives the travel fee and whether the job is profitable at all.

fields.name: Outside Service Area?
fields._why: Stops the pipeline wasting follow-up on jobs that will never be taken.

fields.name: Permit / Venue Approval Needed?
fields._why: Public parks, HOAs and some corporate campuses require approval. An unresolved permit is a booking that silently dies.

fields.name: COI Requested?
fields._why: Certificate of insurance. Routine for corporate clients and managed venues; a pending COI blocks the booking and is easy to forget.

fields.name: Quoted Amount
fields._why: Opportunity value and the basis of the deposit calculation.

fields.name: Quote Sent Date
fields._why: Drives the follow-up cadence. Quote age is the best predictor of a dead lead.

fields.name: Agreement Status
fields._why: The date is NOT held until the agreement is signed. This field is the difference between a hold and a booking.

fields.name: Deposit Status
fields._why: Second half of the hold. Signed + paid = the date is off the board.

fields.name: Deposit Amount
fields._why: Usually a percentage; stored explicitly so reminders can state the real number.

fields.name: Balance Due Date
fields._why: Balance is due some days before the event. Its own date field so the reminder workflow is a simple date trigger.

fields.name: Balance Status
fields._why: Chasing a balance on event morning is the worst possible time. Explicit status makes it chaseable earlier.

fields.name: Reschedule Count
fields._why: Repeated reschedules predict a cancellation and warrant a human call.

fields.name: Weather Risk Flag
fields._why: Makes the weather conversation an auditable state instead of a memory.

fields.name: How Did You Hear About Us?
fields._why: Referral and 'saw us at an event' are dominant channels in this trade. Attribution here decides where marketing money goes.

fields.name: Referred By
fields._why: Names the referrer so they can be thanked. Thanked referrers refer again.

fields.name: Repeat Customer?
fields._why: Annual events (company picnic, same birthday, yearly fundraiser) are the cheapest revenue in the business and are almost always left unworked.

fields.name: Annual Event Month
fields._why: Feeds the anniversary rebooking campaign - reach out ~60 days before the same month next year.

fields.name: AI Conversation Summary
fields._why: Written by the Conversation AI agent on handoff so the human does not restart the conversation from zero.

fields.name: Objection / Hesitation
fields._why: Objections drive which follow-up content to send. Price and 'will guests use it' need completely different answers.

_base_overlap._comment: Same rule as custom_values: retire base fields only after the workflow that uses them is rewritten.
